text.text_excerpt: I joined my friend for a quick weekend trip down in NOLA and after a bit of a debacle with the first room reservation she made, she made another for her and what a great change it was! Her original reservation was at the Hilton on Poydras and this hotel instead was located on Orleans Ave, literally 25 ft from Bourbon st but surprisingly quiet (in a good way). I arrived on Friday night and was greeted by very polite door men, I walked in and was greeted again by an awesome night staff. I wish I had gotten the name of this guy because he was SO so nice to me and pleasant to deal with. My friend had left a key for me under her name and promptly set me up and showed me the "secret" staff elev...

Very nice hotel. Very accommodating and clean. Our room wasn't the greatest, but it did the job. We were there just to keep our stuff in, shower and sleep. It was raining for the most part of our vacay, so we didn't utilize the pool. We wanted to because it was so hot and humid -- but there were thunder storms. The hotel is really convenient because it's right in the French Quarter. Everything is walking distance. Restaurants, shops, bars, cafes, and tour buses. Concierge was great. Everything was perfect I also love the fact that it was part of a historic/ghost tour attraction. People came in and learned the history about the hotel and it's story. Beautiful hotel. I love the little pool in the middle which is heated and has waiter service from the bar. The attached bar is one of the nicer ones around with a good selection of whiskey. The staff was friendly and helpful and from top to bottom was impeccable. I took an Uber from the airport for about $33 each way so didn't have to worry about parking. The location is awesome right in the middle of the French Quarter and adjacent to Bourbon Street, a very short walk to Jackson Square. A great base point to explore the French Quarter.
